title: Senior IT Services Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Senior IT Services Engineer**

**Job Description**  
Serve as a technical leader within IT Services, resolving complex issues, leading service and platform improvements, and advancing automation across identity, endpoint, collaboration, employee lifecycle, and ITSM services. The role owns advanced Windows and macOS endpoint management, including MacBook fleet administration through Iru, mentors engineers, strengthens operational governance, and delivers a secure, reliable, and high-quality user experience, including white-glove support for executives and critical business events.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead troubleshooting for complex incidents affecting users, endpoints, applications, identity, and collaboration services, acting as the escalation point for IT Services Engineers.
* Coordinate cross-functional resolution with Infrastructure, Security, Network, and Application teams.
* Administer and improve Okta SSO, MFA, application integrations, group management, and lifecycle processes, validating access configurations, attribute mappings, and provisioning and deprovisioning flows.
* Drive secure access practices, access reviews, audit readiness, and lifecycle governance.
* Manage advanced administration across Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune, Entra ID, and endpoint services, and lead device deployment, configuration, and service improvements.
* Lead macOS and MacBook fleet management using Iru, including zero-touch deployment through Apple Business Manager, Blueprints, Library items, configuration profiles, app deployment, OS updates, and patching.
* Administer Iru compliance and security controls such as FileVault encryption, Gatekeeper, and device posture policies, and troubleshoot complex macOS hardware, OS, and application issues.
* Deliver white-glove support for executives and VIP users, ensuring technology readiness for executive meetings, presentations, and visits.
* Support and troubleshoot Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Zoom Rooms, and conference room AV, and provide live support for town halls, training sessions, and key business meetings.
* Perform proactive conference room and meeting technology checks to minimize disruption.
* Improve ITSM service catalogs, workflows, dashboards, reports, ticket routing, assignment logic, and SLA practices.
* Design automation using Okta Workflows, FreshService Workflow Automator, Power Automate, scripting, or approved AI-enabled tools.
* Identify recurring issues and implement sustainable fixes, self-service options, and measurable process improvements.
* Lead onboarding, offboarding, contractor management, access updates, device readiness, and asset retrieval, ensuring activities are documented, controlled, timely, and security-aligned.
* Participate in the weekend on-call rotation to handle critical incidents, coordinate escalations, and restore service quickly.
* Mentor engineers, conduct knowledge-sharing sessions, and review technical documentation to strengthen team capability.
* Establish and maintain SOPs, support standards, knowledge content, and operational runbooks.
* Evaluate and responsibly adopt new technologies, AI tools, and automation opportunities that improve service delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–8+ years of experience in IT services, end-user support, or workplace technology operations, including escalation-level responsibilities.
* Advanced administration and troubleshooting across Okta, Microsoft 365, Active Directory or Entra ID, Intune, MECM, and Exchange Online.
* Strong hands-on experience administering Iru (formerly Kandji) to manage MacBooks at scale, including Blueprint design, automated device enrollment through Apple Business Manager, configuration profiles, custom scripts, app deployment, and macOS security and compliance.
* Hands-on experience with Okta SSO, SCIM, MFA, provisioning, deprovisioning, and application integrations.
* Strong ITSM platform knowledge, including FreshService configuration, dashboards, routing, and reporting.
* Experience with automation platforms, scripting, workflow design, and approved AI-enabled tools.
* Strong understanding of endpoint security, compliance controls, conferencing, Zoom Rooms, and audiovisual technologies.
* Strong customer-service orientation with clear verbal and written communication.
* Structured troubleshooting, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Okta Workflows.
* Scripting experience for macOS and Windows automation (e.g., Bash, zsh, Python, or PowerShell).
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading service or process improvement initiatives.
* Proven track record of delivering measurable automation and self-service outcomes.
* Experience supporting audits, access reviews, and security compliance programs.
* Certifications such as Okta Certified Administrator, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator or Microsoft 365 Administrator, and ITIL Foundation or higher.
* Iru (Kandji) certifications or equivalent Apple credentials such as Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) or Apple Certified IT Professional.

**Success Measures**

* Service-level performance, ticket quality, and durable resolution of complex issues.
* Customer experience and reliability of end-user and workplace services.
* Endpoint compliance, security posture, and deployment efficiency across the Windows and macOS fleet.
* Automation adoption and measurable process-improvement outcomes.
* Quality and use of knowledge articles, SOPs, and operational documentation.
* Mentoring, knowledge sharing, and growth of team technical capability.

**Educational Qualification**  
BE/B.Tech/BCA/MCA or B.Sc., preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

description:

Manager, Product ManagementManager (Commercialization), Global Product Management, Operational Intelligence Program  
Job Title:  
Manager (Commercialization), Global Product Management  
  
Overview  
Masterard Data & Services enables customers across industries and geographies to make smarter decisions and reach better outcomes with a tailored portfolio of solutions beyond the transaction.  

* We harness the power of real-time, anonymized, aggregated transaction data; powerful software platforms; and a wealth of expertise
* We empower customers to make better data-driven decisions by unlocking a holistic view of consumer behavior beyond their four walls and distilling actionable insights from data
* We work with financial institutions, retailers, telecommunications organizations, travel companies, and more

This person will be part of a team of product managers and drive key activities including development of the go-to-market strategy, defining the product value proposition and pricing, create sales and delivery materials and play a key role in sales and delivery enablement.
  
This individual will partner closely with other members of the Global Product Management technical team to ensure product strategy, roadmap and vision is aligned with the go-to-market strategy and product business priorities.  
Product Managers in Data & Services at Mastercard  

* Build revolutionary products that advance how businesses all over the world derive the most value from their data assets
* Translate a deep understanding of our customers into products and solutions that drive significant customer value
* Balance the long-term direction of a product with today’s needs and constraints by fully understanding the technical, competitive, and commercial contexts of our products
* Act as connectors to ensure the commercial success of our products by working with Sales and Marketing while ensuring technical success through close partnership with Technology teams
* Drive globally relevant solutions by understanding regional needs and tradeoffs, and build scalable products that serve an array of customer segments
* Set product direction with coordination, not isolation—considering how our products all work together to serve customer needs

  
Role  
  

* Act as an expert, advocate, and champion for OI program products
* Lead global product management team efforts with analytically driven input into strategic business plans and product roadmaps
* Coordinate across cross-functional teams for product sales, usage, and continuous product enhancement
* Lead developing the product business strategy including customer segmentation, pricing, sales, and marketing strategy
* Play a key role in rolling out new solutions focused on new segments (e.g., Fintechs), use cases (e.g., real time alerts, crypto payments), networks (e.g., open banking, Blockchain)
* Manage the product P&L and lead the forecasting/budgeting discussions for the products
* Effectively communicate strategy and vision up and down the organization
* Prioritize development efforts as they align against business strategy

  
All About You  
  

* Agile product management experience in analytical products and business intelligence solutions
* Strong experience with analytical solutions designed for payments or a related financial services sectors preferred
* Analytical, solutions-oriented skillset with the ability to drive thought leadership
* Strategic mind set to solve complex and ambiguous problems
* Keen understanding of competitive offerings and industry trends in the self-service analytics space, and the ability to translate that understanding into meaningful actions and enhancements
* Proven track record collaborating in cross-functional teams to deliver outstanding products and features
* Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities
* Knowledge and skills using product management tools, (e.g., market and product plans, project timelines, marketing research, pricing, business case development)
* Bachelor’s degree in business or relevant experience
* Experience in strategy consulting or developing go-to-market strategies for products
* Experience of developing and driving end to end execution of initiatives – particularly in a cross-functional environment, managing and prioritizing competing initiatives
* Strong communication & influencing skills to work with internal and external stakeholders, with ability to clearly articulate problem statements and opportunity areas
* Strong understanding of the Mastercard products & services and key revenue drivers

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.

Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.

We are looking for an AI-forward **Customer Success & Implementation Lead** to manage the complete post-sales journey for our enterprise customers—from contract handover and implementation to adoption, retention, and growth.

In this role, you will lead the Implementation and Onboarding team, drive successful enterprise deployments, and build scalable customer success processes. You will also use AI-powered development tools to prototype client requirements, automate workflows, analyse technical issues, and accelerate integrations without being completely dependent on the core engineering team.

#### **What will you do at Fynd?**

**Lead Implementation and Delivery**

* Lead and mentor a team of Implementation Managers and Onboarding Specialists.
* Own key implementation metrics, including time-to-go-live, catalog migration, deployment success, and user adoption.
* Manage the complete handover process from Sales to Implementation and Customer Success.
* Oversee the integration of store locations, ERPs, marketplaces, inventory systems, and supply chain workflows.
* Identify implementation risks, resolve delivery bottlenecks, and ensure projects are completed within committed timelines.
* Build scalable playbooks for onboarding, system configuration, customer training, escalation management, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).

**Drive AI-Assisted Technical Solutions**

* Use AI development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Bolt, Lovable, or similar platforms to build functional prototypes, front-end mock-ups, and custom widgets.
* Demonstrate client-specific use cases and Fynd API capabilities through working prototypes.
* Build scripts or lightweight applications to clean and transform retail catalog data, automate customer health scores, and improve onboarding workflows.
* Analyse API logs, JSON payloads, client-side code, and integration issues to identify potential root causes.
* Translate business and technical challenges into clear, actionable specifications for Product and Engineering teams.
* Use AI tools to reduce dependency on engineering teams for routine technical tasks and accelerate customer resolution timelines.

**Own Customer Retention and Growth**

* Build trusted relationships with CXOs, founders, e-commerce leaders, and senior stakeholders across enterprise accounts.
* Act as a strategic advisor and help customers achieve measurable business outcomes through Fynd’s solutions.
* Partner with Account Management and Sales teams to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across Fynd’s product portfolio.
* Own key commercial and customer success metrics, including renewals, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), adoption, and customer health.
* Conduct regular business reviews and proactively address risks that could affect customer satisfaction or retention.
* Consolidate customer feedback and share actionable insights with Product and Engineering teams to influence the product roadmap.

#### **What we're looking for**

* 6–10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Enterprise Implementation, Technical Account Management, or a related role.
* At least 2 years of experience leading an implementation, onboarding, customer success, or engineering-adjacent team.
* Strong experience in Retail Technology, E-commerce, Omnichannel Commerce, Order Management Systems, logistics, or supply chain platforms.
* Understanding of how storefronts, warehouses, ERPs, marketplaces, inventory systems, and physical stores work together.
* Hands-on experience using AI development tools to create functional code, prototypes, scripts, automations, or internal applications.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, databases, and basic data transformation.
* Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with experience managing complex enterprise implementations.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience managing senior stakeholders, including CXOs, founders, and e-commerce leaders.
* A metrics-driven approach with a proven record of improving onboarding timelines, customer adoption, retention, or NRR.
* Strong ownership, problem-solving, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers.

title: Manager, Incentive Compensation
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY:**

The Global Operation Services Center (GOSC) is seeking a highly motivated **Manager, Incentive Compensation Design** to lead incentive compensation strategy and design for Pfizer's Tier 3 International Markets. In this role, you will partner directly with business leaders across diverse global markets to develop bonus plans, quota-setting methodologies, and recognition programs that motivate customer-facing colleagues and drive business performance.

You will serve as a trusted advisor, translating business objectives into incentive compensation solutions that are simple, motivating, fiscally responsible, and compliant with Pfizer policies and governance standards. Working closely with the GOSC Delivery team, you will also lead the successful implementation and ongoing administration of these programs.

This role combines strategic consulting, analytics, and stakeholder management. It is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of data and business strategy, enjoys solving complex performance challenges, and can confidently communicate recommendations to senior leaders. Success in this position requires both strong quantitative capabilities and the ability to influence decision-making through clear, evidence-based insights.

Beyond supporting assigned markets, this role will contribute to broader GOSC strategic initiatives, driving innovation, continuous improvement, and best practices across international incentive compensation programs.

**ROLE RESPOSNSIBILITIES:**

**Incentive Compensation Strategy & Design**

* Design, enhance, and maintain incentive compensation plans aligned with local business strategies and commercial objectives.
* Develop and refine quota-setting methodologies that support performance, fairness, and business growth.
* Design local recognition and award programs that reinforce desired behaviors and strategic priorities.
* Partner with business leaders to identify challenges and proactively recommend incentive compensation solutions.

**Analytics & Strategic Consulting**

* Analyze incentive compensation program effectiveness and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Leverage data and analytics to generate insights, evaluate program performance, and support strategic decision-making.
* Build robust business cases and recommendations for plan design changes, balancing motivation, affordability, and risk management.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to market leadership by providing objective, data-driven guidance.

**Stakeholder Partnership**

* Develop strong relationships with market leaders and gain deep understanding of local business priorities, products, customer dynamics, and competitive landscapes.
* Facilitate discussions and influence stakeholders through credible recommendations and clear communication.
* Collaborate effectively across Commercial Excellence, Finance, PX, Compliance, and other partner functions.

**Program Implementation, Governance & Service Delivery**

* Partner with GOSC Delivery teams to ensure timely, accurate, and effective implementation and administration of incentive compensation programs.
* Collaborate with GOSC to calculate bonus payouts, contests, awards, and field quotas using approved processes, tools, and templates.
* Ensure all incentive compensation deliverables are accurate, complete, and distributed to the field force according to established timelines.
* Own governance and operational oversight across all incentive compensation services within assigned markets.
* Create, maintain, and manage incentive compensation production calendars, ensuring alignment across business, operational, and support stakeholders.
* Hold stakeholders accountable for data ownership, validation, quality, and timely submission of required inputs.
* Implement new processes, tools, and initiatives in alignment with regional and global standards, guidelines, and strategic priorities.
* Maintain audit readiness through accurate documentation, record retention, and archiving practices in partnership with GOSC.
* Ensure adherence to all relevant incentive compensation policies, procedures, governance requirements, and Legal and Compliance standards, including GMIS policy application.

**Analytics & Strategic Consulting**

* Analyze incentive compensation program effectiveness and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Generate, maintain, and communicate incentive compensation analyses, reports, dashboards, and insights to monitor program health and support business decision-making.
* Leverage data and analytics to identify trends, evaluate program performance, and recommend improvements aligned with market objectives.
* Build robust business cases for compensation plan and quota-setting enhancements, balancing motivation, affordability, and compliance.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to market leadership by providing objective, data-driven recommendations and solutions.

**Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead strategic projects and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance GOSC's value proposition, service delivery, and operational effectiveness.
* Proactively identify business needs and opportunities to improve existing services, processes, tools, and incentive compensation programs.
* Drive the adoption of best practices, innovation, and standardization across supported international markets.
* Work independently and lead by influence, delivering on business strategies, goals, and objectives through strong analytical, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Success Factors**

The successful candidate will:

* Demonstrate a strong balance of analytical rigor, business acumen, and stakeholder influence.
* Be equally comfortable developing complex incentive compensation models and presenting recommendations to senior business leaders.
* Operate with a high degree of ownership, accountability, and independent judgment.
* Effectively manage multiple priorities across diverse international markets while maintaining attention to detail and execution excellence.
* Build trust through data-driven decision making, collaboration, and consistent delivery of high-quality results.
* Champion continuous improvement and proactively identify opportunities to enhance business value.

**QUALIFICATION:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Data Science, Operations Research, Business Analytics, Economics, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline. An MBA or other advanced degree is preferred.
* **5-10 years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or related industry, with a focus on Commercial Operations, Sales Force Effectiveness, Incentive Compensation, Business Analytics, or Process Improvement.**
* **Demonstrated experience designing, optimizing, or supporting incentive compensation programs, sales performance management processes, or other commercial operations initiatives.**
* Proven ability to manage complex operational timelines, coordinate tasks across multiple stakeholders, and ensure delivery against critical business deadlines.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with experience translating complex data into actionable business insights and recommendations.

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------


We are seeking an experienced technology pricing professional to lead the commercial design and pricing of complex, high\-value opportunities during the pre\-signature phase. This location\-agnostic role sits within Technology Commercial Support, Growth, and reports to a Senior Technology Account Manager or market\-specific Technology Account Manager.
You will act as the pricing lead for strategic opportunities, typically valued at €10 million to €30 million in total contract value, or support larger and more complex bids. You will develop value\-led, competitive and governable commercial constructs while protecting margin, addressing commercial risk and aligning pricing decisions with market conditions.
Working across defined strategic accounts, sub\-accounts or opportunity portfolios, you will collaborate with Technology Account Managers, pricing teams, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments, Digital \& IT leaders and customer stakeholders.**What you’ll do**
------------------


### **Pricing and commercial design**

* Shape end\-to\-end commercial constructs for new technology opportunities, aligning the pricing approach with deal strategy, customer requirements and risk profile.
* Define pricing strategies that balance competitiveness, margin protection and long\-term value.
* Build, review and approve complex pricing models, including sensitivity, scenario and profitability analysis.
* Apply relevant pricing constructs, including time and materials, Managed Services, output\-based and gain\-share models.
* Clearly document and govern pricing assumptions, commercial risks, dependencies and guardrails.
* Set pricing strategies and commercial constructs within Growth governance, escalating material risks or deviations where required.
* Provide commercial analysis, market insight and competitor perspectives to support informed pricing decisions.

### **Bid support and governance**

* Lead pricing activity within bid squads for opportunities typically valued at €10 million to €30 million, or provide pricing leadership within larger, multi\-tower bids.
* Coordinate commercial inputs for requests for information, requests for proposal and customer submissions.
* Create detailed pricing models, submission packs, proposal artefacts and governance documentation.
* Assure the quality, consistency, accuracy and completeness of all pricing deliverables.
* Coordinate with solution, pricing and commercial support teams to meet bid timelines and quality requirements.
* Support opportunity and pipeline qualification, together with pricing approval processes, in line with Growth governance.
* Maintain disciplined delivery across multiple customers and concurrent opportunities.
* Enable an effective transition from Growth to business\-as\-usual teams by documenting pricing assumptions and commercial guardrails.

### **Stakeholder and customer engagement**

* Build collaborative relationships with key VOIS stakeholders, customer service owners and service leads.
* Work closely with Senior Technology Account Managers, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments and Digital \& IT leaders.
* Participate in customer engagement activities and contribute commercial insight to the shaping of deals and solutions.
* Communicate pricing strategies, commercial risks and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Guide commercial support colleagues working within bid teams.

### **Measures of success**

* Competitiveness of pricing and contribution to successful deal outcomes.
* Protection of margin and realisation of value on signed opportunities.
* Quality and governance of pricing models, submissions and supporting artefacts.
* On\-time delivery of pricing inputs for bids and proposals.
* Effective transition of pricing assumptions and guardrails into business\-as\-usual execution.
**Who you are**
---------------


### **Essential knowledge and capabilities**

* You have expert capability in pricing, financial modelling and commercial analysis.
* You demonstrate commercial acumen and a detailed understanding of deal economics, profitability and risk drivers.
* You can design and communicate pricing strategies for complex technology opportunities.
* You have advanced Microsoft Excel skills and can develop complex financial models, sensitivity analyses and commercial scenarios.
* You apply a high level of attention to detail, structured governance and quality assurance.
* You communicate clearly in writing and verbally with senior internal and customer stakeholders.
* You use relevant market and competitor insight to inform pricing decisions.
* You can prioritise effectively and manage concurrent work across multiple customers and opportunities.
* You demonstrate Vodafone Spirit behaviours.
* You apply independent judgement to create tailored commercial approaches rather than relying solely on standard pricing methods.

### **Experience**

* You have extensive pricing or commercial support experience in IT services, telecommunications or systems integration.
* You will typically bring 15 to 18 years of overall professional experience, including 7 to 10 years in senior pricing, bid or commercial roles.
* You have practical knowledge of time and materials, Managed Services, output\-based and gain\-share pricing constructs.

Swiggy is India’s leading on\-demand delivery platform with a tech\-first approach to logistics and a solution\-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500\+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh\+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on\-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning\-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.

**Overview**
------------


A Key Account Manager owns high\-value restaurant partners within an assigned city, typically chains, established multi\-outlet restaurants, and growing independents expanding to multiple locations. These accounts are more complex: they involve negotiations with multiple stakeholders, larger deal sizes, custom solutions, and deeper engagement around ROI and strategy. You combine field presence with office\-based analysis and executive relationship management. Success requires both relationship skills and the analytical ability to build customized business cases. You mentor the Sales Manager tier and own a portion of the city\-wide targets.

------------------------

* Own a portfolio of multi\-outlet restaurants: Manage 30\-40 high\-value accounts(60 to 80 in case of Indianext cities), each with 2\-10 outlets. These accounts represent 40\-60% of city revenue

* Consultative strategy: Move beyond product features. Help restaurants think about their growth strategy across, e.g., optimizing delivery times, increasing order frequency, and cross\-location consistency
* Field presence with data: Conduct monthly visits to key accounts to understand operations, gather feedback, troubleshoot adoption barriers, and surface new opportunities
* Advanced analytics: Build detailed business reviews (QBR) for accounts. Analyze their performance across cuisine, compare against benchmarks, and present growth strategies
* Pipeline development: Identify expansion opportunities with existing accounts (new locations, new products/cuisine). Turn your relationship into revenue growth
* Excel excellence: Build executive presentations, ROI models for pitches, and monthly and quarterly business reviews with charts and trend analysis. Your spreadsheets must be presentation\-ready for C\-level stakeholders

* Track record in managing multi\-stakeholder deals

* Advanced Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data visualization, forecasting. You should be able to build a dashboard for each RP, which can help you and the restaurant partner to keep track of their business with us

Job Description \- Curated Experience (Executive)
  
Role Summary
  
The Curated Experience Executive shall work closely in co\-ordination with the Curated Experience Sr. Executive ensuring visibility and presence on a day\-to\-day requirement \& ensure organization associates and visitors are welcomed, valued, and taken care of at every stage while they are in the office.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Guest Experience
  
The Executive is the first face a colleague sees and the last impression a guest carries with them. This means expressing warmth and professionalism at reception or entry, greeting people with care, and creating an atmosphere where every individual feels that their presence matters. Beyond the greeting, the Executive takes ownership of the physical readiness of the workplace by conducting regular and thorough checks of meeting rooms, collaboration spaces, pantries, and common areas to ensure everything is clean, stocked, and ready for use before it is needed. Responding to ad\-hoc colleague requests is done promptly and with a helpful spirit, and feedback collected during daily interactions is documented accurately and shared with the Sr. Executive to drive meaningful resolutions.
  
  

Operational Support
  
The Executive plays an active role in keeping daily operations flowing smoothly. Service requests are logged, tracked, and followed through to full resolution, with timely status updates provided to colleagues along the way. Daily site inspections are conducted with a watchful eye, identifying maintenance issues, supply gaps, or safety concerns before they escalate. Routine matters are channeled to the Curated Experience Sr. Executive, while safety or security concerns are escalated directly and immediately to the Facility Manager / Security Team. Trackers, logs, and basic operational reports are maintained with accuracy and consistency.
  
  

Conference \& Event Support
  
Executive ensures every room is set up to the highest standard viz., equipment tested, AV confirmed, refreshments in place (where requested), and the space reset promptly after every meeting concludes. For workplace events, training sessions, and engagement activities, the Executive provides dedicated on\-ground support, working alongside the Sr. Executive to deliver a seamless experience for every attendee.
  
  

Colleague Engagement \& Onboarding
  
Executive shall play a central role in making new hires feel genuinely at home from day one. Leading the site orientation tours, introducing colleagues to amenities, explaining workplace policies, and setting a warm and welcoming tone are all core to this responsibility. All colleague enquiries, whether received in person, via email or through chat are acknowledged and responded to within one business day. Executive also takes an active approach to learning by shadowing the Curated Experience Sr. Executive across site functions, building both capability and confidence within the Workplace Services environment.
  
  

Feedback \& Continuous Improvement
  
Executive shall gather real\-time experience feedback from colleagues and stakeholders during daily interactions, tours, and events, and document it accurately using designated trackers. This feedback need to be shared promptly with the Sr. Executive for review and closure, and the Executive follows up on minor items to confirm resolution. Beyond reactive feedback, Executive proactively reviews the service patterns, whether supply shortages, AV readiness issues, or space concerns contributing meaningfully to a culture of continuous improvement that elevates the experience for everyone.
  
  

Transport \& Commute Support
  
Executive serves as a trusted first point of contact for routine transport and commute queries, helping colleagues (especially new hires) navigate shuttle schedules, parking allocations, and booking protocols with confidence and ease. Complex issues, complaints, or service disruptions are escalated promptly to the Sr. Executive or the Transport team, ensuring no colleague is left without a resolution.
  
  

Additional Workplace Responsibilities
  
Executive supports visitor badging, temporary access requests, and compliance with site security protocols, ensuring access is managed seamlessly and in accordance with established guidelines. Workplace policies including clean desk standards, appropriate use of shared spaces, and visitor management are reinforced in a friendly, hospitality first manner that reflects the values of the Curated Experience team. Contractors and vendors on site are supported with basic orientation and access to amenities, ensuring their presence is well\-integrated and non\-disruptive. Throughout all of this, Executive remains observant and proactive, flagging risks, hazards, or service concerns to the Sr. Executive or Facility Manager without delay.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

**Education \& Experience:**  

A Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification is preferred with Two to three years of experience in hospitality, customer service, front desk management, facilities coordination, or a closely related field. Candidates who bring a passion for people are strongly encouraged to apply, even if their background spans multiple industries.
  
  

**Skills \& Competencies:**  

The ideal candidate is warm, approachable, and genuinely service\-oriented, someone who takes pride in the details and finds satisfaction in making others feel cared for. Strong verbal and written communication skills, excellent organizational abilities, and composure to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment are essential. Cultural sensitivity, patience under pressure, and the ability to de\-escalate situations with grace are highly valued. A collaborative spirit, a strong willingness to learn and grow, and proficiency in the Microsoft Office including Teams, Outlook, Excel, and Word.
  
  

Working Hours
  
Flexibility to support early morning or late evening / night activities is required based on site needs, including shift\-based working arrangements where applicable.
  
  

Reporting Structure
  
The Curated Experience Executive reports directly to the Curated Experience Sr. Executive and works in close day\-to\-day collaboration with Facility Management teams across the site.
